Decision cutoff: 2026-03-17T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Announcing Copilot leadership update. Published date: 2026-03-17. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/03/17/announcing-copilot-leadership-update.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Satya Nadella, Chairman and CEO, and Mustafa Suleyman, Executive Vice President and CEO of Microsoft AI, shared the below communications with Microsoft employees this morning. This will span four connected pillars: Copilot experience, Copilot platform, Microsoft 365 apps, and AI models. Jacob Andreou will lead the Copilot experience across consumer and commercial, driving design, product, growth, and engineering, as EVP, Copilot, reporting to me. Ryan Roslansky, Perry Clarke, and Charles Lamanna will lead M365 apps and the Copilot platform. As you will have just heard from Satya, the next phase of this plan is to restructure our organization to enable me to focus all my energy on our Superintelligence efforts and be able to deliver world class models for Microsoft over the next 5 years.
